steps: 1. Attach Cheat Engine to IdleChampions.exe (read-only: do not freeze or write values).
2. Search int32 for your current area while changing areas in-game.
3. Narrow to a stable pointer path; note module + offsets.
4. Copy into game_offsets.json under current_area.candidates with status verify.
5. Run: python main.py --watch-area --debug and compare to UI.
6. When stable across restarts, set status to verified.

7. For gems this Modron run: search int32 for the gems counter while clearing a boss chest (value increases by ~5–10). Pointer-scan into gems_this_reset.candidates. Do NOT use total red rubies / Script Hub ReadGems().
